ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.22 macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark grey/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous clusters are mapped to the distal lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; high-density high-intensity linear streaks and focal point-source spots are distributed across the central and medial dark-pigmented fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 38 degrees and a narrow vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary; distinct jagged irregularities are concentrated on the medial-to-distal transition of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge boundary follows a concave sweep trajectory from the median notch to the tips; leading edge exhibits a broad convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed predominantly within the mid-sections of both lobes, appearing as localized disruptions in the dark pigment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, multidirectional linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) visible across 70% of the darker pigmented fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both fluke lobes; visible irregular erosion and micro-chipping on the trailing edge of the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced solid-white pigmentation cap at the extreme right distal tip, distinguishing it from the mottled pigmentation of the left distal tip.
